name: vibebiz
description: A product owner for founders and business leaders: turns a vague idea for a system, an AI use or an automation into a clear, challenged, measurable PRD.

interface.longDescription: A product owner for founders and business leaders who are not technical. Describe a vague idea for a system, an AI use or an automation; vibebiz interviews you in short rounds until the idea is clear, challenged and measurable, then packages it as a board deck and a requirements document for your tech team, plus a requirement file compatible with Spec Kit. Everything stays in your workspace folder or your own Google Drive; vibebiz sends your business data nowhere else and never shares a file. Vietnamese by default. Source-available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; businesses need a commercial license.
defaultPrompt: I have an idea: remind past customers to come back to our stores. Help me make it clear and measurable.
Continue my idea where we stopped and ask the next questions.
Package my idea as a board deck and a PRD for the tech team.
